bug_semantics: The authenticated Engine UI proxy handler accepted the destination host and port directly from /engine-ui/<host>:<port>/... and constructed an outbound HTTP URL without restricting that destination. Any remote requester able to reach the handler could therefore make the Kyuubi server contact arbitrary network-reachable HTTP services, yielding SSRF/open-proxy behavior and possible confidentiality, integrity, or availability impact.
flaw_origin: The smallest reconstructed first-writer is PR #4795 member 3b0152f33b2c03ddd2b86c6ec8541661e01b039a: it added EngineUIProxyServlet.scala, parsed host and port from the request path, formed http://<host>:<port>/..., registered the /engine-ui servlet, and attached it to KyuubiRestFrontendService without any destination policy. The main-branch squash 4cd00a8777043fca4348d2c2f3a2b0b6e358e028 is only the aggregate landing commit, not the smallest BIC.
ai_marker: Absent on BIC 3b0152f33b2c03ddd2b86c6ec8541661e01b039a. Its commit object names human author zwangsheng <2213335496@qq.com>, human committer Cheng Pan <chengpan@apache.org>, and has the one-line message '[KYUUBI #3420][UI] Proxy Engnie UI' with no Co-Authored-By, Generated-with, Assisted-by, bot identity, or other AI attribution trailer. AI disclosure on the 2026 fix is excluded because only the BIC commit object is admissible.
evidence: Apache's first-party advisory at https://lists.apache.org/thread/ps79fcfx49ox9kwgztc5t5bw0tyhck9m states the request-path host/port SSRF/open-proxy mechanism, affected range 1.8.0 before 1.12.0, and upgrade/configuration remedy. In the validated clone, `git log --follow -- kyuubi-server/src/main/scala/org/apache/kyuubi/server/api/EngineUIProxyServlet.scala` starts at squash 4cd00a8777043fca4348d2c2f3a2b0b6e358e028; `git log -L 31,49:kyuubi-server/src/main/scala/org/apache/kyuubi/server/api/EngineUIProxyServlet.scala aa58942b57eb21a67ce97a4b6404b2d9c0cce878` attributes the unrestricted rewrite to 4cd00a8777043fca4348d2c2f3a2b0b6e358e028, while `git log --all -S'new URL("http", host, port' -- .../EngineUIProxyServlet.scala` returns 4cd00a8777043fca4348d2c2f3a2b0b6e358e028 as the addition and 7067644e1bf469a761b0516ce73b432a2ebf9f9d as its removal. `git show 4cd00a8777043fca4348d2c2f3a2b0b6e358e028` identifies all eight squashed PR members. https://api.github.com/repos/apache/kyuubi/pulls/4795/commits resolves those members; https://api.github.com/repos/apache/kyuubi/commits/3b0152f33b2c03ddd2b86c6ec8541661e01b039a shows the first member added EngineUIProxyServlet.scala with request-derived host/port and parent cb689b66b1ed745a5e38dea37a2b0f1d9e7f1aca. Direct parent verification with `git grep -n -e EngineUIProxyServlet -e engine-ui cb689b66b1ed745a5e38dea37a2b0f1d9e7f1aca -- kyuubi-server/src/main kyuubi-server/web-ui/src` returns no match, whereas the BIC API diff marks the servlet file added and shows registration of the handler. `git show 7067644e1bf469a761b0516ce73b432a2ebf9f9d` shows the closing change: proxy disabled by default, explicit allowed-host patterns when enabled, strict URI parsing, and null/403 for disallowed targets; its direct parent aa58942b57eb21a67ce97a4b6404b2d9c0cce878 still contains `new URL("http", host, port, ...)` and lacks FRONTEND_REST_ENGINE_UI_PROXY_ENABLED. `git tag --contains 4cd00a8777043fca4348d2c2f3a2b0b6e358e028 --list 'v1.7*' 'v1.8.0'` returns only v1.8.0; `git grep` shows the unrestricted constructor in v1.8.0 and v1.11.1; `git tag --contains 7067644e1bf469a761b0516ce73b432a2ebf9f9d --list 'v1.11*' 'v1.12*'` returns v1.12.0/v1.12.0-rc0 only, and v1.12.0 contains allowedTarget plus the proxy-enabled configuration default false. The BIC API's signed commit payload reproduces the human identities and trailer-free one-line message used for the AI check.
reasoning: The vulnerability is the destination-trust decision, not the later query-string enhancement: the very first proxy implementation already let the requester select the outbound host and port. Main history exposes that implementation as squash 4cd00a8777043fca4348d2c2f3a2b0b6e358e028, but the retained PR chain proves that 3b0152f33b2c03ddd2b86c6ec8541661e01b039a is the smaller original writer and that its immediate parent lacks both the servlet and route. The Apache advisory, ancestry/tag checks, vulnerable tagged blobs, and fixed tagged policy agree on 1.8.0 <= version < 1.12.0 and on 7067644e1bf469a761b0516ce73b432a2ebf9f9d as the closing mainline fix. Because the only admissible object for attribution is the decomposed BIC and that object contains only human identities with no AI marker, the closed verdict is NOT_AI; the fix commit's Assisted-by: OpenCode (GPT-5.5) disclosure cannot causally attribute the 2023 flaw.
